hero.lead: Korean firming serum with NAD+, EGF and collagen extract. Absorbs in thirty seconds, no greasy film.

actifs.lead: No fragrance, no alcohol, no essential oils. This bottle contains what is documented, and nothing else.
actifs.a1_p: Nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide. Boosts cellular energy and helps the skin activate its own repair mechanisms. Its production declines with age.
actifs.a2_p: Epidermal growth factor. Supports cell renewal and helps smooth the skin's texture. Used in Korean dermatology for over ten years.
actifs.a2_note: Star active of Korean anti-aging care
actifs.a3_p: Reinforces the skin's firmness and elasticity. Completes the action of NAD+ and EGF for a visible firming effect.

faq.q1: Which skin types is it for?
faq.r1: All of them. The formula is fragrance-free, alcohol-free, essential-oil-free. Sensitive skin included.
faq.q2: When do you see the first results?
faq.r2: Hydration is immediate. The firming and smoothing effects appear within two to four weeks of daily use.
faq.q3: Can it be used with other skincare?
faq.r3: Yes. It goes on after cleansing and before your cream. Compatible with retinol, vitamin C and AHAs/BHAs.
faq.q4: How long does one bottle last?
faq.r4: A 30 ml bottle lasts about a month at 3 to 4 drops a day. Morning and night: count on three weeks.
faq.q5: Where does the serum come from?
faq.r5: Formula developed in South Korea, K-beauty expertise. 12-month PAO after opening.
faq.inci: Full INCI list on the product packaging.
